source: NCERT Class XII, Fundamentals of Human Geography, Ch. 7 (Tertiary and Quaternary Activities).

sections.heading: 1. Tertiary Activities — Services
points: **Tertiary activities** = the **service sector** — they provide **services**, not goods.
Include **trade, transport, communication, banking, insurance, tourism, health, education, administration**.
They involve **skills, expertise and labour** rather than raw materials.

sections.heading: 2. Types of Tertiary Activities
points: **Trade and commerce** — retail and wholesale (moving goods from producers to consumers).
**Transport** — moving people/goods (roads, rail, water, air, pipelines).
**Communication** — transmitting information (post, telephone, internet, mass media).
**Services** — professional, personal, business services; **tourism** is a major service industry.

sections.heading: 3. Quaternary and Quinary Activities
points: **Quaternary activities** = the **knowledge sector** — collection, production and dissemination of **information/knowledge** (research and development, IT, consultancy, education, finance).
**Quinary activities** = the highest level — **decision-making and specialised knowledge** (top executives, policymakers, scientists — 'gold-collar' professions).
These reflect an advanced, service/knowledge-based economy.

sections.heading: 4. Outsourcing and the New Economy
points: **Outsourcing (BPO)** — contracting out business/knowledge work to other companies/countries (e.g. call centres, IT services in India).
The **digital divide** — inequality in access to information technology.
The share of tertiary/quaternary activities rises with economic development (post-industrial economy).

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Tertiary = services (trade, transport, banking, tourism, health, education).
Quaternary = knowledge sector (R&D, IT, consultancy, finance).
Quinary = highest decision-making ('gold-collar' professionals).
Outsourcing (BPO) = contracting out work (India = major hub).
Digital divide = unequal access to IT.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Tertiary = services**; **quaternary = knowledge/information**; **quinary = high-level decision-making**.
**Quaternary activities** involve **research and knowledge** (not physical production).
**Outsourcing/BPO** contracts out work to other firms/countries.
The service/knowledge sectors grow with **economic development**.
